name: cRZStopwatch::cRZStopwatch(int mode)
notes: Hooked (src/hook/tables/cRZStopwatch.cpp, not run in-game; about 40 callers). cRZStopwatch_Construct: 11 modes x three fills, whole 0x18 bytes compared (the dword at +4 is never written). Mutation check: dropping the accumulated-count clear killed (see the Elapsed run).

name: cRZStopwatch::Start
notes: Hooked (not run in-game). Modes other than 0: exact against the scripted QueryPerformanceCounter slot (rz_stopwatch.cpp). Mode 0 (StopwatchMode0 test): the original's call target 0x1c9244 has its first 5 bytes replaced by a jump to a scripted fake, ours reads the same script through sTimeStampCounterOverride; 300 cases, whole object, exactly one TSC read and no QPC read. Mutation check: mode test inverted/mode 1 killed (both files).

name: cRZStopwatch::Elapsed
notes: Hooked (not run in-game). 20,000 scripted cases for modes 1..8 and negative modes with random calibration globals (0x10cb648 overhead, five float scales at 0x10cb650, read through GameAddress because the calibration at 0x1c906a is not reimplemented): spans before the start, at the overhead edges, far past it; counts past 53 bits and past 2^63 with float tie values; exact result and one counter read only when started. Mode 0 is exact in tests/stopwatch_tsc.cpp (the helper 0x1c9244 redirected to a scripted fake in the original, same script for ours: 5000 cases with start words, overhead edges, wrapped spans; one TSC read when started, no QPC read). Mutants: reading the TSC in mode 1 instead of 0 killed. Mutation check: overhead edge (>= and ? 0 : 1), mode bounds, scale index, shift of the raw result, float rounding via double (unsigned), always reading the counter, all killed; two equivalent survivors: lower mode bound 1 (modes 0 and 1 return earlier) and int64 to float directly (MSVC compiles that through the same _ltod3 double step).

name: cRZStopwatch::ReadTsc (cpuid, rdtsc into *out; cdecl)
notes: Hooked (not run in-game). Lane HQ: difftest cRZStopwatch_ReadTscTrace through a seam both sides go through (tests/cpu_trace.h): each side is single-stepped (trap flag, a vectored handler) and every cpuid / rdtsc it executes is answered from the same script (the TSC values: 0, 1, 2^32 - 1, 2^32, 2^63 - 1, 2^63, all ones, random) instead of the hardware's; 300 cases, compared: *out with 8-byte canaries on both sides, the instructions met in order (exactly cpuid then rdtsc), the callee-saved registers and esp at the return. The cpuid leaf and subleaf are not compared: the original runs cpuid on the eax its caller left (0x1c924a) and reads none of its answer (rdtsc at 0x1c924c overwrites eax / edx, the pop at 0x1c9254 restores ebx, ecx is scratch); ours uses leaf 0. tests/rz_stopwatch.cpp's hardware check (back to back, ours later by under 3e9 ticks) stays. Mutants (filter cRZStopwatch): rdtsc before cpuid, cpuid removed, value halved, high half dropped: all killed. The sTimeStampCounterOverride seam stays for its callers' tests.

name: cRZStopwatch::ReadPerformanceCounter (QueryPerformanceCounter into *out; cdecl, returns its BOOL)
notes: Hooked (not run in-game). Scripted fake on both sides (200 values incl. all ones), one call each, result TRUE; plus the real counter on both sides, ours never behind the original. Mutation check: returning 0 instead of the BOOL killed. Lane FA: reads through the owned import slot 0xd9a24c (ImportSlot), so image-free programs bind it to QueryPerformanceCounter.

name: cRZStopwatch::SetCount(int64 units) (accumulated = units in the mode's unit via the inverse scales at 0x10cb664, then start = counter now; thiscall ret 8)
notes: Hooked (cRZStopwatch_SetCount), not run in-game (one caller seen: 0xc9e950). 20000 cases: modes -4..9, scales incl. 0, NaN, inf, negative, huge; units incl. INT64 limits; scaled value placed on and around 2^63 and 2^64 (the unsigned-conversion branch); compares the whole 0x18 bytes and the log of counter reads (TSC helper redirected in the original). Mutants killed: add-back removed or forced, mode 7 accepted, scale index, mode 1 split from 0, start from the wrong counter, >= vs > on the 2^63 compare after subtraction. Equivalent survivors: scaled >= 2^63 as > (at exactly 2^63 both give 0x8000000000000000), int64 straight to float (MSVC compiles both through _ltod3).

name: cRZStopwatch::MeasureFrequency(uint64* queryPerformanceFrequency, uint64* tscFrequency) (start-up calibration probe; cdecl)
notes: Hooked (cRZStopwatch_MeasureFrequency), not run in-game. The caller 0x1c8d8e passes 0x10ff2480 (QPF) and 0x10ff2488 (TSC rate); only the second is cleared first, the first is written last. 6000 cases with QueryPerformanceCounter/Frequency/SleepEx faked in the IAT, the TSC helper redirected, one shared random script per side; compares both outputs, canaries past them, the cache cell (0x10cb63c: none, zero, nonzero) and the full call log (order, values). Ratio boundaries 0.98 and 1.02 are hit exactly (counter multiples of 50). Mutants killed: >= at either boundary, 4 tries, 0.34 s, SleepEx(100,0), bias dropped, cache not stored, cache ignored, measuring with a cache, wrong output for QPF, unsigned conversion. Equivalent survivor: rate > 2^63 instead of >= (at exactly 2^63 both give 0x8000000000000000).
